query:
SELECT 
  SUM(CAST(s.finalAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_final_amount,
  (SELECT SUM(si.quantity * si.unitPrice) 
   FROM saleItems si 
   JOIN sales s2 ON si.saleId = s2.id 
   WHERE MONTH(CONVERT_TZ(s2.saleDate, '+00:00', '-03:00')) = 12 
     AND YEAR(CONVERT_TZ(s2.saleDate, '+00:00', '-03:00')) = 2025
     AND s2.status != 'CANCELLED') as total_items_value
FROM sales s
WHERE MONTH(CONVERT_TZ(s.saleDate, '+00:00', '-03:00')) = 12 
  AND YEAR(CONVERT_TZ(s.saleDate, '+00:00', '-03:00')) = 2025
  AND s.status != 'CANCELLED';
